sourceTitle: How to use Gemini to update your resume
originalTitle: How to use Gemini to update your resume
author: Kimberly Fusaro

blocks.text: 1. Open Gemini and ramble at it about all your past roles. 2. Add this prompt: “Act as a professional resume writer. Use my raw, unedited notes about my past work and turn it into four high-impact resume bullets for a _______ role. Start each bullet with a strong action verb. Keep the tone executive, clear, and ATS-friendly." 3. Chat back and forth to adjust details, tone, and focus. 4. Copy and paste it into your resume when it’s done.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言打开Gemini 并大声疾呼 关于你所有过去的角色。2. 将第1款改为第2款。添加此提示 :“担任职业履历作家。用我的生来,关于我过去的工作的未经编辑的笔记, 并把它变成四个高影响 恢复子弹的作用。以强烈的动作动词启动每颗子弹.保持音调高管,清楚了吗?并方便苯丙胺类兴奋剂。"来回聊天来调整细节语气,和焦点。4个。复制并粘贴到您的履历上。
